messages:
ben: heads-up — deploying a small routing/config tweak to prod in ~10m (16:15 PT). This is a lightweight change (routing weight + small TTL tweak). Plan: start canary -> run `smoke_small.json` prompt set -> monitor per-route p95, error-rate, and cache hit. rollback criteria: >5% 5xx OR p95 increase >50% sustained for 5m. @anya can you standby for smoke + quick fixes? @matt please watch infra.

deploy-bot: canary started on canary-group-7 (2 nodes) — tag `canary-1724681234`

anya: on it. will run the smoke checklist and paste results here. share canary URL pls.

ben: canary URL: https://canary.prod.redwood/api/v1/generate — using prompt set `smoke_small.json` from repo `infra/smoke/`

matt: watching GPU pools and autoscaler. will flag if any throttling or queue buildup.

anya: running initial smoke: 20 requests across 2 models (model-alpha, model-beta). checking responses for 5xx, correctness, and latency.

anya: initial smoke results: 20/20 OK, p50 ~80ms, p95 ~190ms, no 5xx, KV cache hit ~72%. posting logs snippet:
```
REQ 1: 200 OK, tokens 32, latency 75ms
REQ 20: 200 OK, tokens 29, latency 210ms
```

leo: observability note — model-alpha p95 bumped from 210ms -> 280ms right after deploy start, traffic is low though so sample size small. no 5xx spike.

ben: thanks. holding promotion for 10m to see if p95 settles. if stable we'll promote.

anya: small functional diff noticed on one prompt — extra trailing whitespace in structured field. low severity. opening quick PR `#2345` to strip whitespace at post-process. not blocking promote.

matt: can add a CI lint to catch that formatting, will push a tiny job to the smoke workflow.

deploy-bot: promotion to prod initiated (rolling).

ben: promotion complete. kicking post-promote quickscan (100 requests over 5m).

anya: post-promote quickscan (results): 100 reqs, error-rate 0.6%, p95 ~220ms, no 5xx. CPU/GPU usage normal. cost per 1k tokens within expected band. :thumbsup:

leo: seeing a small uptick in 429s for model-beta tied to a single client — applied a temp quota. unrelated to this change but visible during scan.

ben: rollback criteria not met. we'll keep a 15m watch then close this. thx everyone for quick turnaround. please add the formatting case to the smoke set (`smoke_small.json`) and merge PR #2345 after CI. :rocket:

anya: will add test and follow up in PR. closing watch in 15m unless anything else shows up.

matt: added CI lint job and triggered a run. if it passes I'll merge the lint and the fix after the watch window.

deploy-bot: watch window started (15m) — monitoring alerts will post here.

ben: all clear from me — nothing else on my side. great job.
__notes: single-thread Slack export style; messages are chronological, short, includes bot msgs and code block.
